info.title: HTC Supply Management System API
info.description: Bearer-token API for active system accounts. SMO may read all requisitions; other users may read their own. Limits: 60 authenticated requests/minute/user, 10 submissions/minute/user, and login limits of 5/minute/login and 20/minute/IP. Tokens expire after 24 hours by default. Monetary values are PHP decimal strings. See REST_API.md for workflow details.
